review:
这款桌面回合制游戏。
内容为玩家扮演盗贼在城市里一边试图建立工会，一边和其它盗贼竞争。
用孤儿渗透城市获得资源，用恶棍阻碍对方发展，建立帮派来帮自己抢夺地盘，雇佣炸弹手来守护建筑或者探索地图，雇佣孤儿院长来驱逐对方的孤儿，雇佣姐妹会的刺客来消灭目标。获得胜利的方法是集攒数量不定的胜利点，贿赂官员，暗杀权贵，或让孤儿偷听他人的忏悔来勒索她们都是赢取胜利点的方法。
部分地图还有特殊的胜利方法。游戏难度上手不高，过了教程就能会个大半。
画风方面相当不错，可爱的画风带着些精致，好比在恶棍加入帮派后人数的添加，或是驱逐敌方孤儿时的动画都很精致。
小学的时候玩过盗版，当时觉得挺好玩的记忆犹新，现在心血来潮又回来重温了下，好玩，只不过主线战役的内容不多，趁着打折的话这价位绝对推荐

I feel like they missed the mark on this. The game is fantastic in a way, but each match is too short. More depth, have the matches be more like 80+ turns each, and it would be exceptional. As it is...the matches don't have enough moves, which limits the possible options and strategies. I like the general bones of the game, but it's just the bones of what it could have and should have been. You need to hustle bam bam BAM as fast as you can, there's not enough build up of the sides.

If there's an Anti-hero 2, I'll definitely be looking closely at it. If it's longer matches, I'll almost certainly buy it. But if it's just more of the same short matches with so few turns...I'd give it a pass.

我最早接触到这款游戏是在小学，当时是在移动端玩的盗版。多年后又想起这款游戏，在steam上购买并游玩。总的来说，作为一款桌游这款游戏的设计是恰到好处的，唯一的遗憾是制作组没有进行进一步的玩法扩展，游玩体验较为单一。另外，这款游戏的售价相较于同质量的桌游是明显更贵的，其推出的dlc只对游戏形象做出了扩展，但没有实质性的玩法扩展，因此不建议购买。
对于有意游玩策略桌游的玩家，这款游戏是一个选择，但就性价比而言，它不是最好的选择。

Text Review:

Pros:
-Great, cartoony yet dark, cute yet edgy, angular yet bulbous visuals (It's a dark, criminal underworld caricature of Victorian/ Dickensian London)
-Good, regal, Victorian-inspired music (Fits with the setting and visuals as it shifts from serious to industrious and playful although usually it's sinister)
-Great, well thought out gameplay! It actually feels strategic or at least I, in my limited understanding, can't see an obvious exploit that will win the match outright (Although getting two gangs and leveling them to max seems like a good play). It seems like every move has a counter as far as I can tell and the tech tree may cater to different play styles ("I prefer having extra moves and a strong economy to gang warfare" some may say). It plays more like a strategy game than a boardgame because luck only determines what neighbourhoods are created where as well as when and where neutral contracts and thugs spawn.

Maybes:
-The campaign mostly consists of levels where you play a multiplayer game mode against the AI (Perhaps not the most interesting excercise to play a boardgame against AI) and is maybe more of an extended tutorial but it has a couple of unique levels you can only play on the campaign and it's rare for boardgames to have a campaign!
-It's a boardgame with only two player capability which is rare
-The story is very light and does not strain itself (It's more here to give a justification to that kind of campaign) but it succeeds atmospherically and has funny neighbourhood names

Otherwise you only get 10 campaign chapters, all with their unique maps and goals and antagonists, etc., but ultimately the game pretty much boils down to the same fundamentals. Scout, rob, infiltrate and accrue victory points, while unlocking the same tech tree every time. It's a nice game, but the campaign will only take you about 5 hours maybe. Two pseudo complaints I have:
- You can absolutely dominate the other player/AI if you're lucky/smart enough, to the point that they're basically out of options, but still have to suffer through 10 more turns until you finally win. Once you've managed to oust all their holdings and burgle all available property, there's not much left for them to do. Lanterns become meaningless at some point, and the only way to then generate more gold is to burgle art or diamonds, which requires a gang to do in the same turn. By that point in the game the other player constantly has 2 gangs out, whacking everything you own, while your thief in itself can't do much even with the 3 damage upgrade. Gangs at that point can either have more than enough HP ... or it just doesn't matter, because they're essentially just bodies, like Thugs, which can be endlessly respawned, since there's no cooldown or other penalty for losing them. I.e. There is no catch-up mechanic once you've fallen that far behind. Which in itself would be fine if the game actually ended then, but you can reach this state without having a single victory point. From then on the other player can only watch you play and win.

There's no option to play with more people. While I understand that this would severely impact the game balance I think it might be a lot of fun. Bigger maps, more players, more chaos, less chances of the aforementioned holding pattern failure state, even if you got destroyed early on, the fact that not 1 but 2 or 3 other players are still vying for control would give you some opportunities, even if just as a sort of "hitman for hire". Games could drag out a bit, though... so maybe that's another idea better reserved for a physical version, which, to my knowledge, does not exist, unfortunately. :/

A brilliant board-game developed by a single person, and is maintained throughout the years. He still actively responds on Steam forums and the Discord server. The single-player campaign is very short (10 missions), but enjoyable nonetheless. AI is not very smart, so the single player random map mode is for trying out strategies and learning the maps mostly. Multiplayer mode is the fun part. There is a live and an asynchronous mode with a ranking system (casual match). Not many people play live, so your best bet is giving a shout at the Discord server if you want to play live. You can still find matches in the asynchronous mode after all these years. However, the only people who regularly play are the long time veterans, so you will definitely lose in the beginning and will be playing with a small player base. Looking on the bright side, you will learn a lot from them. Get this amazing and cute board game, and spread the love. This game definitely deserves a far wider audience.

FYI. You can also play it on your Android phone/tablet. This is very convenient for the asynchronous mode since you have to check whether your opponent played their turn etc. However, to play the game on your Android you have to purchase the game from the playstore a second time.
